payload.name: Fintent.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and prioritize companies showing signs of M&A activity, capital raising, or financial distress with Fintent’s predictive signals.

Built for private equity, investment banking, and deal sourcing teams, Fintent brings company scores, historical trends, and deal-maker research activity into your conversations.

With Fintent, you can:

• Check M&A, CapRaise, Distress, and Deal-Maker scores for individual companies or lists of company domains.
• Review saved screeners to identify new signals, rising activity, and companies worth a closer look.
• Explore up to 12 months of weekly signal history to understand when activity started and how it has changed.
• See the research topics behind signals and the private equity, investment banking, venture capital, and law firms researching a company.
• Create screeners from company lists, add companies, and remove companies you no longer want to track.
• Export screeners and their historical signals to Excel.

Use Fintent to prepare for company conversations, review target lists, monitor potential opportunities, and prioritize outreach.

Requires a Fintent account.
payload.longDescription:
通过Fintent的预测信号，发现并优先处理显示出并购活动、融资或财务困境迹象的公司。

Fintent专为私募股权、投资银行和交易团队打造，将公司评分、历史趋势和交易专家研究活动融入您的对话中。

使用Fintent，您可以：

• 检查单个公司或公司域名列表的并购、融资、困境和交易专家评分。
• 查看保存的筛选器，识别新信号、活动上升趋势以及值得关注的公司。
• 探索长达12个月的每周信号历史记录，了解活动开始时间及变化情况。
• 查看信号背后的研究主题，以及正在研究某公司的私募股权、投行、风投和律所信息。
• 通过公司列表创建筛选器，添加或移除您不再关注的公司。
• 将筛选器及其历史信号导出至Excel。

使用Fintent为商务洽谈做准备、审查目标清单、监控潜在机会并优先安排接触。

需要Fintent账户。

payload.name: IPOInsider
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IPOInsider gives ChatGPT read-only access to IPOInsider's IPO database: the current IPO universe with company, symbol, status, industry, exchange, offer date and price, proceeds, market cap and lifetime return; the pricing calendar for any date window, including deals that have not priced yet; the underwriting syndicate of every deal with the left-lead bank identified; company, ticker and underwriter name lookup; and point-in-time history showing the whole universe or a single deal as it stood on any past date. Typical workflows: count or screen IPOs by offer date, status, industry, exchange, proceeds or market cap; list what is pricing this week or this month; look up one deal by ticker; rank or filter deals by the bank that led them; and compare a deal or the market today with an earlier snapshot. SPAC deals are always excluded and are covered by the separate SPACInsider app. Every tool queries IPOInsider's own database and returns structured data; nothing is written, sent or fetched from the public internet. A SPACInsider account enabled for the IPOInsider MCP is required.
payload.longDescription:
IPOInsider为ChatGPT提供对IPOInsider IPO数据库的只读访问权限：当前IPO全量数据，包含公司名称、股票代码、状态、行业、交易所、发行日期和价格、募集金额、市值及全周期回报率；任意日期窗口的定价日历，包含尚未定价的交易；每笔交易的承销团信息并标明主承销商；通过公司名称、股票代码或承销商名称进行查询；以及时间点历史数据，可查看任意历史日期的全量数据或单个交易状态。
典型工作流程包括：按发行日期、状态、行业、交易所、募集金额或市值对IPO进行计数或筛选；列出本周或本月正在定价的交易；通过股票代码查找单个交易；按主导承销商对交易进行排名或过滤；以及将当前交易或市场与之前的快照进行对比。
SPAC交易始终被排除在外，需通过独立的SPACInsider应用处理。
所有工具均查询IPOInsider自有数据库并返回结构化数据；不会从公共互联网中写入、发送或获取任何内容。
需要启用IPOInsider MCP功能的SPACInsider账户。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Türkiye bordro mevzuatına göre net maaştan brüt maaş ve bordro hesaplamaları yapar. SGK, gelir vergisi, damga vergisi, işçi ve işveren maliyetleri gibi bordro kalemlerini hesaplayarak aylık sonuçlar sunar.

payload.name: Revelata deepKPI
payload.description: 提取关键绩效指标和SEC文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Revelata deepKPI gives ChatGPT and Codex read-only access to financial and operating KPIs extracted from SEC filings for US public companies, with up to 10 years of history updated daily. Retrieve KPI time series and catalogs, company summaries and segments, and SEC filing markdown with source links for auditability. Built for equity research, diligence, and financial analysis. Requires sign-in to an existing Revelata account.
payload.longDescription:
Revelata deepKPI为ChatGPT和Codex提供只读访问权限，可获取美国上市公司SEC文件中提取的财务及运营关键绩效指标，包含最多10年的历史数据且每日更新。
可检索关键绩效指标时间序列和目录、公司摘要及业务部门信息，以及带有来源链接的SEC文件Markdown格式内容以确保可追溯性。

payload.name: Spera
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Spera helps users create, inspect, revise, and compile private trading strategies, reusable modules, and custom nodes; run exact-revision backtests; and maintain project knowledge and artifact documentation. It does not deploy live trading bots, place trades, or access exchange credentials.
payload.longDescription: Spera助力用户创建、检查、修订并编译私人交易策略、可复用模块及自定义节点；执行精确版本回测；维护项目知识与制品文档。该工具不支持实时交易机器人部署、交易下单或访问交易所凭证。

payload.name: Mortgage Industry Regulations
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
C4C: Mortgage Industry Regulations gives ChatGPT the actual text of U.S. mortgage regulations and agency guides: HUD Handbook 4000.1, the Fannie Mae Selling and Servicing Guides, the Freddie Mac Guide, the Ginnie Mae MBS Guide, the VA Lenders Handbook (M26-7) and USDA HB-1-3555, plus the CFR and U.S. Code sections they rest on.

Ask a question the way you'd ask a colleague, in plain words or loan-file shorthand like "DTI" or "RSU income". ChatGPT finds the governing section, quotes it verbatim, and gives you the citation, the effective date and the dated source document it came from. It flags when a rule has two versions in force, a pending revision, or was changed by a later letter. It can also look up a citation you already have (B3-4.3-04, 4000.1 II.A.4.c, 12 CFR 1026.43) and check whether a passage, including one from your own draft, really appears in the regulator's text.

Four guided worflows: FHA, VA and USDA loan-file QC, and a review against Fannie Mae's AI Lender Letter LL-2026-04. Each check comes back with the rule it rests on, and your documents stay in your chat.

Read-only, with no sign-in or account. Questions outside mortgage regulation get "not found" rather than a stretch. Results are for research and are not legal advice: verify against the primary source.
payload.longDescription:
C4C：抵押贷款法规功能为ChatGPT提供了美国抵押贷款法规和监管机构指南的原文，包括《HUD手册4000.1》、房利美《销售与服务指南》、房地美指南、吉利美MBS指南、VA贷款商手册（M26-7）和农业部HB-1-3555手册，以及它们所依据的《联邦法规》和《美国法典》条款。

您可以像向同事提问一样用日常语言，或使用贷款文件缩写（如"DTI"或"RSU收入"）提问。ChatGPT会查找相关条款，逐字引用并提供引用信息、生效日期以及原始来源文件的日期。当某项规定存在两个现行版本、 pending修订或被后续信函修改时，系统会特别标注。您也可以查询已有引用信息（如B3-4.3-04、4000.1 II.A.4.c、12 CFR 1026.43），并验证某段内容（包括您自己起草的文本）是否确实出现在监管机构原文中。

包含四个引导流程：FHA、VA和农业部贷款文件质量检查，以及针对房利美AI贷款信LL-2026-04的审查。每次检查结果都会显示对应的规定条款，且您的文件会保留在聊天记录中。

仅限只读模式，无需登录或账户。超出抵押贷款法规范围的问题将返回"未找到"而非猜测性回答。结果仅供研究参考，不构成法律建议，请以官方原文为准。

payload.name: Twelve Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Twelve Data for current and historical market information. Look up prices, time series, technical indicators, company fundamentals, earnings, dividends, market movers, analyst data, regulatory filings, and reference data for stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, forex, crypto, and commodities. Users authenticate with their own Twelve Data account, so available data and rate limits follow their plan. Market data is informational and is not investment advice.
payload.longDescription: 将ChatGPT连接至Twelve Data以获取实时和历史市场信息。查询股票、ETF、共同基金、外汇、加密货币和商品的价格、时间序列、技术指标、公司基本面、收益、股息、市场动向、分析师数据、监管文件及参考数据。用户需使用自己的Twelve Data账户进行认证，因此可用数据和速率限制将遵循其账户计划。市场数据仅供参考，不构成投资建议。

payload.name: Waypoint Budget
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Waypoint Budget is a budgeting app built for Canadian and US banks. This plugin lets ChatGPT read the budget you have open in the app: spending by category and merchant, planned versus spent for the month, individual transactions in small batches, savings and debt goals, account balances, upcoming recurring expenses and income, and net worth. Every tool is read-only. Nothing can be added, changed or deleted, and account numbers are never shared. The connection is off by default, turned on by you in Profile, then Integrations, and can be switched off at any time, which disconnects every assistant immediately.
payload.longDescription: Waypoint Budget 是一款专为加拿大和美国银行设计的预算应用。此插件允许 ChatGPT 读取您在应用中打开的预算信息，包括按类别和商户划分的支出、本月计划支出与实际支出对比、以小批量呈现的单笔交易、储蓄与债务目标、账户余额、即将发生的定期支出和收入以及净资产价值。所有工具均为只读模式，无法添加、修改或删除任何内容，且账户号码永远不会被共享。连接默认处于关闭状态，您可在资料库-集成中手动开启，且可随时关闭，这将立即断开所有助手的连接。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Exact, official steps to cancel about 80 popular US and UK subscriptions (streaming, music, audiobooks, Amazon Prime, Costco, Walmart+, delivery passes, gyms such as Planet Fitness and LA Fitness, news, meal kits, Adobe, Microsoft 365, iCloud+, Apple One, Canva, Chegg, Norton and other software, game passes, dating apps, meditation and diet apps, Ring and Nest camera plans, Apple and Google Play in-app subscriptions, phone and internet add-ons). Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://cancelmysub.pages.dev

取消约80种热门美国和英国订阅服务的准确官方步骤（流媒体、音乐、有声书、Amazon Prime、Costco、Walmart+、配送通行证、健身俱乐部如Planet Fitness和LA Fitness、新闻、餐食套餐、Adobe、Microsoft 365、iCloud+、Apple One、Canva、Chegg、Norton及其他软件、游戏通行证、约会应用、冥想与饮食应用、Ring和Nest摄像头计划、Apple和Google Play应用内订阅、手机及网络附加服务）。

payload.name: CoverForce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CoverForce gives licensed agents, retail agencies, wholesalers and MGAs real-time commercial insurance quotes from 60+ carrier products. Describe a risk in plain language and CoverForce builds the submission, asks only the underwriting questions that carrier actually needs, and returns bindable quotes side by side. Coverage includes Workers' Comp, BOP, GL, Cyber, MPL, and more. When you're ready to bind, you complete the application on CoverForce's secure platform or directly with the selected carrier.

CoverForce is technology infrastructure, not an insurance agency. Every quote runs under your own agency's carrier appointments: CoverForce verifies your broker codes with each carrier at setup, then submits through that carrier's live API. Agents in a wholesaler or network program can also quote under a partner's appointments where that access has been granted. More than $1.2 billion in premium has been quoted through the platform, across 50,000+ submissions a month.

CoverForce is available to U.S.-based insurance professionals only. You need an active property & casualty license in the states you quote, and an agency with a verified CoverForce account and active carrier appointments — register at coverforce.com. You'll only see carriers, products and states your agency is appointed and licensed for. Quotes are indicative until a carrier confirms and binds them, and remain subject to carrier underwriting and appetite. Policy issuance, servicing and all claims are handled directly by the issuing carrier.

By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and may be shared with CoverForce, your agency, participating insurance carriers and service providers for the purpose of providing you with insurance quotes. Please only share the business information needed to quote the risk, and no additional sensitive information. To learn more about how CoverForce processes your information, see our privacy policy at www.coverforce.com .

payload.name: Find My Money
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Where to look for money owed to you in the US: each state's official unclaimed property search (all 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico), MissingMoney.com, and federal sources for old tax refunds, lost 401(k)s and pensions, savings bonds, failed banks and credit unions, failed brokerages (SIPC), life insurance of someone who died (NAIC Policy Locator), the Social Security lump-sum death payment, Individual Indian Money accounts, and FTC, SEC, CFPB and HUD refunds. Takes several states at once (every state the user lived or worked in) and gives a claim checklist, including for heirs. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. More at https://findmymoney.pages.dev
payload.longDescription:
在美国寻找应属于你的钱的去处：各州官方未领取财产查询（涵盖全部50个州、华盛顿特区和波多黎各）、MissingMoney.com，以及联邦层面的旧税款退税、丢失的401(k)账户和养老金、储蓄债券、倒闭银行和信用社、倒闭经纪公司（SIPC）、他人去世后的人寿保险（NAIC保单定位器）、社会保障局一次性丧葬补助金、印第安人个人账户，以及联邦贸易委员会、证券交易委员会、消费者金融保护局和住房与城市发展部的退款。
可同时查询多个州（用户曾居住或工作过的所有州）并提供索赔检查清单，包含继承人相关条款。
所有工具均为只读模式：无需登录，且不会存储任何用户信息。
无任何广告或付费推广内容。
由Good Turn Studio开发。
更多信息请访问 https://findmymoney.pages.dev

payload.name: Capable Cap Table
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Capable Cap Table connects ChatGPT to your startup's cap table in Capable, the AI-native cap table and equity management platform. Ask about ownership, equity and fundraising in plain language, and draft changes for an admin to approve.

Founders, finance, legal and HR admins can:
- See who owns what on a fully diluted basis, by stakeholder and by share class, including the option pool.
- Look up any stakeholder's stock options (ISO and NSO), RSUs, restricted stock (RSAs), warrants, SAFEs and convertible notes.
- Check vesting schedules, cliffs and the next vesting dates.
- Check the current 409A valuation, its fair market value per share and when it expires.
- Model a priced round (Seed, Series A and later), including SAFE and note conversion and an option pool top-up, and see the dilution for each holder.
- Model an exit and see what each holder takes home after liquidation preferences.
- Get links to export the cap table to Excel, CSV or OCF, and review recent activity and pending proposals.

Employees, advisors and investors can ask about their own equity: how much has vested, the next vesting dates, exercise prices and deadlines.

Example questions:
- Who owns what in our cap table, fully diluted?
- List our outstanding SAFEs with their valuation caps.
- How much will the founders be diluted if we raise $10M at a $40M pre-money valuation?
- When does our 409A expire?
- If we sell the company for $150M, what does each holder take home?

ChatGPT can draft a change, such as a new stakeholder, an option grant, a termination, a cancellation or a 409A record, as a proposal. Nothing changes until an admin approves the proposal inside Capable.

Capable shows each person only what they are allowed to see. Round and exit models are planning estimates, not tax, legal or investment advice. The plugin does not move money or place trades.
payload.longDescription:
Capable Cap Table将ChatGPT连接到Capable中的创业公司股权表，这是AI原生的股权表和股权管理平台。您可以用通俗语言询问所有权、股权和融资问题，并起草更改建议供管理员审批。

创始人、财务、法务和人力资源管理员可：
- 以完全稀释基础上查看各利益相关方和股份类别（包括期权池）的持股情况。
- 查询任何利益相关方的股票期权（ISO和NSO）、限制性股票单位（RSUs）、限制性股票（RSAs）、认股权证、SAFE和可转债。
- 查看行权时间表、锁定期和下次行权日期。
- 查看当前409A估值、每股公允市场价值及到期时间。
- 模拟定价轮次（种子轮、A轮及后续轮次），包括SAFE和债券转换以及期权池追加，并查看各持有者的稀释情况。
- 模拟退出情况，查看各持有者在清算偏好后的实际所得。
- 获取导出股权表至Excel、CSV或OCF的链接，并查看近期活动和待审批提案。

员工、顾问和投资者可以查询自己的股权信息：已行权数量、下次行权日期、行权价格和截止期限。

示例问题：
- 我们的股权表中各利益相关方的完全稀释持股情况如何？
- 列出我们所有未到期的SAFE及其估值上限。
- 如果我们以4000万美元的投前估值融资1000万美元，创始人会稀释多少？
- 我们的409A估值何时到期？
- 如果以1.5亿美元出售公司，各持有者能拿回多少钱？

ChatGPT可以起草更改建议，例如新增利益相关方、期权授予、终止、取消或409A记录，并作为提案提交。
未经Capable内部管理员审批，任何内容都不会生效。

Capable会根据权限仅展示对应内容。
轮次和退出模拟仅为规划估算，不构成税务、法律或投资建议。
该插件不会进行资金操作或下单交易。

payload.name: The Coin Daily
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Coin Daily is a daily crypto news publication. This connector exposes its Research desk to your assistant: focused price charts with replay and A/B selection; funding, open interest, liquidations and order-book readings on the API's own observation clocks; hourly market-regime and volatility context; governed group comparisons (for example decentralised-finance versus AI-related crypto projects); source-linked news and video timelines; and the latest published Market Update with its chapters. Fourteen data tools retrieve evidence and fourteen focused widgets display it — widgets never invent values and missing readings stay gaps. There is no trading, order placement, wallet or payment action, and outputs are editorial market commentary, not personalised investment advice; the one preparation tool starts a bounded server-side computation and writes nothing of yours. A current membership (or trial/complimentary access) is required; sign-in uses OAuth 2.1 through the connector.
payload.longDescription: The Coin Daily 是一份每日加密货币新闻出版物。该连接器将研究台功能开放给您的助手：包含回放和A/B选择功能的聚焦价格图表；通过API自带的观察时钟展示资金费率、未平仓合约、清算和订单簿读数；每小时更新的市场状态和波动率背景；受控组比较（例如去中心化金融与人工智能相关加密项目）；关联原始来源的新闻和视频时间线；以及最新发布的《市场更新》报告及其章节内容。十四种数据工具收集证据，十四种聚焦小部件展示数据——小部件不会虚构数值，缺失数据时段会保留空白。该工具不提供交易、下单、钱包或支付功能，输出内容为编辑制作的市场评论而非个性化投资建议；唯一的一个准备工具仅启动有限的服务器端计算，并不会保存您的任何数据。需要当前会员资格（或试用/免费访问权限）；登录功能通过连接器使用OAuth 2.1协议。

payload.name: Bullflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Compare returned observations with their dates, timestamps, and filters, or create a custom alert using criteria you specify.

payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中使用Bullflow研究期权交易活动并管理已保存的自定义警报。探索领先的期权标的、净权利金、伽马值与瓦纳值暴露、暗池交易及交易价格。将返回的观察结果与其日期、时间戳和筛选条件进行对比，或使用您指定的标准创建自定义警报。

需要拥有有效API订阅的Bullflow账户。通过Bullflow OAuth连接并批准请求的权限。该插件支持市场研究和警报功能；不执行交易、管理经纪账户或销售订阅。市场观察结果仅供参考，不保证未来表现。

payload.name: Insourcia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Insourcia gives your assistant direct access to French company data: 30 million registered entities, 17 million of them active, with 32 million director mandates, 7 million filed annual accounts and 20 million legal events.

The connector covers five things.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

OfficeHubb never asks for a Social Security, driver license, Medicare, card or bank number, and an assistant can never sign you up for text messages.

仅提供信息。FocusPulse不提供投资建议、价格目标或买卖建议。摘要由软件从已发表文章中生成，可能包含错误；来源链接会指向原始报道。无需账户即可使用。每分钟请求次数限制为60次。

payload.name: GrantLedger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GrantLedger is the open ledger of public funding: grants, loans, guarantees and tax credits published by official bodies in 21 European countries and EU-wide programmes, collected every night from official sources and searchable in any language. Ask which calls fund an industrial SME in Spain, what a loan guarantee in Germany requires, or which EU programmes fit a deep-tech startup; every answer links the official publisher page. Pro accounts can paste the link of their GrantLedger screening result: the assistant reads the company profile they confirmed and every call screened for it with the rule each verdict relies on, then ranks, explains gaps and compares calls. Verdicts come from fixed rules on grantledger.eu, never from the model. Sign in with your GrantLedger Pro account when ChatGPT asks. Read only: the plugin cannot change your profiles or your account.
payload.longDescription: GrantLedger是欧洲公共资金的公开账本：包含21个欧洲国家及欧盟范围计划的拨款、贷款、担保和税收抵免信息，每日从官方渠道收集并支持多语言搜索。可查询西班牙工业中小企业的资助计划、德国贷款担保要求或适合深科技初创企业的欧盟计划；每个答案均链接至官方发布页面。Pro账户可粘贴GrantLedger筛选结果链接，助手将读取已确认的企业资料及针对该企业的所有筛选结果，并根据每项结论依赖的规则进行排序、解释差异并比较资助计划。结论来源于grantledger.eu的固定规则，而非模型生成。当ChatGPT提示时，请使用GrantLedger Pro账户登录。仅限只读：插件无法修改您的资料或账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search public funding calls across Europe by text, country, status and type, Read the full record of a call with the official publisher link, Read a GrantLedger screening result from its link and explain each verdict, Rank, compare and explain calls for a company profile

payload.name: WalletGraph: Address Lookup
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WalletGraph connects public entities, accounts, and onchain addresses when an authoritative source supports the relationship. Look up an exact address or account to see its relationship type, review date, and evidence URL. Coverage is limited to a small reviewed index of published protocol and token contracts. Empty results mean no reviewed mapping is in this index. WalletGraph does not infer personal wallet ownership, request API keys, access GMGN accounts, or execute trades.
payload.longDescription: 当存在权威来源支持该关联关系时，WalletGraph会将公共实体、账户和链上地址进行关联。查询特定地址或账户，以查看其关联类型、审核日期和证据链接。覆盖范围仅限于已审核的已发布协议和代币合约的小型索引。无结果表示该索引中未收录任何已审核的映射。WalletGraph不会推断个人钱包所有权、请求API密钥、访问GMGN账户或执行交易。

payload.name: UAE Gratuity Calculator
payload.description: 阿联酋服务结束津贴计算器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enter your start date, last working day and monthly basic salary. The calculator applies the 21-day and 30-day rates, the one-year minimum, unpaid leave, part-time hours and the cap under Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021. DIFC employees see the gratuity owed for service before February 2020 and their DEWS contribution rate. ADGM employees get the 2024 rules with no cap. Every answer shows the law it used and the assumptions where the law is silent. General information only, not personalised advice.
payload.longDescription:
输入您的入职日期、最后工作日和月基本工资。
计算工具会应用21天和30天的费率、一年最低服务期、无薪假期、兼职工时以及2021年第33号联邦法令规定的封顶金额。
DIFC员工可查看2020年2月前服务期的津贴金额及DEWS缴费比例。
ADGM员工适用2024年规则且无封顶金额。
每个计算结果都会显示所依据的法律条款以及法律未明确规定时的假设条件。
仅提供一般性信息，不构成个性化建议。

payload.name: Seaworthy Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seaworthy Insurance estimates what individual disability insurance would cost you, based on your occupation, age, sex, and income. The prices come from more than 400 carrier illustrations Seaworthy ran in 2026 across five disability insurers. They are built from Texas illustrations, so your state can change the final premium, ages 46 to 55 are projected from the illustrated ages, and some ranges include a professional or training discount. No carrier is named.

The card opens on the benefit and plan design Seaworthy's advisors usually start with for someone in your position. From there you can change the monthly benefit, the waiting period, inflation protection, and catastrophic coverage, and the estimate updates as you go. Every estimate is priced with a true own-occupation definition, partial disability coverage, and benefits to age 65, and the advisor confirms what your occupation class can get.

When you want real quotes, the card sends your request to a licensed Seaworthy advisor, who follows up within one business day. Requesting quotes is free and asks no health questions. These are estimates, not quotes, and underwriting and health history set the final premium.

Seaworthy Insurance is an independent disability insurance brokerage for physicians, dentists, CRNAs, attorneys, tech professionals, and other high earners, licensed in all 50 states.
payload.longDescription:
Seaworthy Insurance会根据您的职业、年龄、性别和收入估算个人残疾保险的费用。价格数据来自Seaworthy在2026年针对五家残疾保险公司运行的400多份承保人图示。这些数据基于得克萨斯州的图示生成，因此您的所在州可能会影响最终保费，46至55岁人群的保费是根据图示年龄预测的，部分费率范围包含专业或培训折扣。未提及任何具体承保人。

该卡片会从Seaworthy顾问通常为您的情况设计的保障方案和计划配置开始。您可以在此基础上调整月度保障金额、等待期、通胀保护和重大疾病保障，调整过程中估算金额会实时更新。每次估算均采用真正的职业定义、部分残疾保障，并覆盖至65岁年龄，顾问会确认您的职业类别可获得的保障范围。

当您需要真实报价时，该卡片会将请求发送给持牌的Seaworthy顾问，顾问将在一个工作日内跟进。请求报价完全免费且无需回答健康问题。以上均为估算数据，最终保费需通过核保和健康记录确定。

Seaworthy Insurance是面向医生、牙医、麻醉护士执业者（CRNAs）、律师、科技专业人员及其他高收入人群的独立残疾保险经纪公司，已在全美50个州取得执业许可。

payload.name: Jelli
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jelli is a budgeting app where your money is sorted into virtual jars. Connect it and ChatGPT can see your jars, transactions, spending trends and recurring charges, check whether your banks are syncing, and draft changes for you: sorting unassigned transactions into jars using Jelli's own suggestions, moving money between jars, creating or editing jars, and splitting a paycheck. Every change is previewed first and only applied when you say so. Jelli never moves real money, and nothing here can.
payload.longDescription: Jelli是一款预算应用，会将您的资金分入虚拟钱罐中。连接Jelli后，ChatGPT可以查看您的钱罐、交易记录、消费趋势和定期费用，检查您的银行账户是否同步，并为您草拟更改方案：根据Jelli的建议将未分类交易归入对应钱罐、在钱罐间调拨资金、创建或编辑钱罐，以及拆分工资。所有更改都会先预览，仅在您确认后才会执行。Jelli永远不会动用真实资金，此处的任何操作都不会导致实际资金变动。

payload.name: Pappers France
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pappers gives ChatGPT access to French legal and public data from more than a hundred official sources, updated daily.

- Companies: search companies by name or criteria and read their profiles (SIREN, directors, beneficial owners, filings, annual accounts, ownership maps).
- Compliance: screen individuals against politically exposed person (PEP) and international sanctions lists.
- Legal: explore French case law and legislation, and get sourced legal research notes.
- Real estate: query land-registry and property data (parcels, owners, sales, buildings, energy-performance certificates).
- Politics: follow French and EU parliamentary activity (members of parliament, votes, amendments, bills) and local-government documents.

Designed for financial analysis, sales screening, investment and M&A, compliance and due diligence (KYC, KYB, AML), legal research, real estate, local-government monitoring, and public affairs, all from a single connector.

Limitations: coverage is limited to French entities and French and EU public records. A Pappers account is required, and beneficial-owner data requires a legitimate-interest authorization. The plugin only reads data: it cannot file formalities, change registry records, or access private information such as bank accounts. Results are informational and are not legal, financial, or credit advice.
payload.longDescription:
Pappers为ChatGPT提供法国官方数据源的访问权限，涵盖来自100多个权威渠道的法律及公共数据，每日更新。

- 公司信息：通过名称或条件搜索公司并查看其档案（SIREN编号、董事、受益所有人、文件、年度财报、股权结构图）。
- 合规审查：将个人与政治敏感人物（PEP）及国际制裁名单进行比对。
- 法律信息：探索法国判例法和法律法规，获取来源可靠的法律研究笔记。
- 房产信息：查询土地登记和房产数据（地块、业主、交易记录、建筑物、能效证书）。
- 政治动态：跟踪法国及欧盟议会活动（议员、投票记录、修正案、法案）和地方政府文件。

适用于金融分析、销售尽调、投资与并购、合规审查（KYC/KYB/AML）、法律研究、房地产分析、地方政府监控及公共事务管理，所有功能通过单一连接器实现。

限制条件：仅覆盖法国实体及法国和欧盟的公共记录。
需要注册Pappers账户，受益所有人数据需提供合法利益授权。
该插件仅支持数据读取功能，无法办理官方手续、修改登记记录或访问银行账户等私有信息。
查询结果仅作信息参考，不构成法律、财务或信用建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Rechercher des entreprises françaises, Consulter les fiches et documents des entreprises, Analyser les comptes annuels, Identifier les dirigeants et bénéficiaires effectifs, Cartographier les liens capitalistiques et de direction, Vérifier les listes PPE et de sanctions, Rechercher dans la jurisprudence, Rechercher dans les lois et règlements, Obtenir des notes de recherche juridique sourcées, Rechercher des parcelles et des ventes immobilières, Rechercher les documents et votes parlementaires, Rechercher les documents des collectivités locales

payload.name: iAsig
payload.description: 摩尔多瓦汽车保险报价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
iAsig is a Moldovan insurance platform. Connect your iAsig account to compare car insurance offers from licensed Moldovan insurers without leaving the chat.

What you can do:
- Get live RCA (mandatory motor third-party liability) prices for vehicles registered in Moldova.
- Get live Green Card prices for Europe or Ukraine, from 15 days to one year.
- Use the vehicles and people already saved in your iAsig account, so you do not retype registration certificate or ID numbers.
- When you pick an offer, get a link to continue on iasig.md. There the order is prepared in your own iAsig account, you review it and you pay. Nothing is bought or charged in ChatGPT.
- Check the status of your iAsig orders.

Privacy: the assistant only sees masked data (for example the last digits of a plate or ID number). It never sees or asks for card details. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time at mcp.iasig.md/connections.

Other iAsig products (travel, home, CASCO, vignettes and more) are available on iasig.md.
payload.longDescription:
iAsig是摩尔多瓦的保险平台。
将您的iAsig账户连接起来，即可在不离开聊天界面的情况下，比较摩尔多瓦持牌保险公司提供的汽车保险报价。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 获取注册在摩尔多瓦的车辆的实时RCA（强制性机动车第三方责任险）价格。
- 获取面向欧洲或乌克兰的实时绿卡价格，期限从15天到1年。
- 使用您iAsig账户中已保存的车辆和人员信息，无需重复输入注册证书或身份证号码。
- 选择报价后，可获取链接继续前往iasig.md。
在该页面您的订单将在个人iAsig账户中生成，您可以进行审核并完成支付。
ChatGPT中不会发生任何购买或扣费行为。
- 查看您的iAsig订单状态。

隐私保护：助手仅能看到屏蔽数据（例如车牌或身份证号的最后几位数字）。
它永远不会查看或要求提供卡号信息。
您可以在mcp.iasig.md/connections随时断开ChatGPT连接。

其他iAsig产品（旅行保险、家庭保险、全险、通行费等）可在iasig.md获取。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Compare RCA prices for vehicles registered in Moldova, Compare Green Card prices for Europe or Ukraine, Use your saved vehicles and people, Continue to iasig.md to review and pay, Check your iAsig order status

payload.name: Edgio Signals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mit Edgio Signals kannst du in ChatGPT den aktuellen Stand der Edgio-Signale für Aktien, ETFs und Sektoren abrufen. Edgio ist ein signalbasiertes Analyse-Tool für Aktien- und ETF-Anleger. Das Plugin gibt die öffentlich zugänglichen Signale im Chat wieder.

Das kannst du damit tun:
- Einen Wert einordnen: der aktuelle Edgio Score von 0 bis 100, die Signale dahinter (Trend, Momentum, Oszillatoren, relative Stärke), Risikokennzahlen und die Position im Sektor.
- Zwei oder drei Werte vergleichen: Score, Performance, Volatilität und Drawdown nebeneinander.
- Einen Sektor einordnen: die Verteilung der Scores und der Durchschnitt im Vergleich zum Gesamtuniversum.
- Den Markt-Pulse abrufen: ein Überblick über das kuratierte Universum mit den Sektoren mit dem höchsten und dem niedrigsten durchschnittlichen Score.

Jede Antwort nennt den Datenstand, die Quelle mit Link und eine Offenlegung möglicher Interessenkonflikte des Gründers. Es ist keine Anmeldung nötig.

Gut zu wissen: Das Plugin deckt nur das kuratierte Edgio-Universum ab und liefert keine Echtzeitkurse. Es führt keine Orders aus, greift nicht auf dein Depot zu und zeigt weder Kursziele noch vollständige Ranglisten. Die Ergebnisse beschreiben den Zustand zum genannten Datum. Sie sind beschreibende Marktinformationen, keine persönliche Anlageberatung und keine Empfehlung.
payload.longDescription:
通过Edgio Signals，你可以在ChatGPT中查询股票、ETF及行业板块的实时Edgio信号。
Edgio是面向股票和ETF投资者的基于信号的分析工具。
该插件会展示Chat中可公开获取的信号数据。

你可以通过以下方式使用：
- 对单一资产进行分析：显示当前Edgio评分（0-100分）、背后的信号类型（趋势、动量、震荡指标、相对强度）、风险指标以及行业位置。
- 对比两到三个资产：并列展示评分、表现、波动率和回撤数据。
- 对行业板块进行分析：显示该板块评分分布情况及与整体市场的平均分对比。
- 获取市场脉搏：查看精选资产池的概览，包含平均分最高和最低的行业板块。

每次回复都会标注数据更新时间、来源链接，并声明创始人可能存在的利益冲突。
使用无需注册。

需要注意：该插件仅覆盖经过筛选的Edgio数据库，不提供实时行情。
不执行交易操作，不访问你的投资组合，不展示价格目标或完整排名。
所有结果仅反映标注日期的市场状态。
这些信息仅作市场描述用途，不构成投资建议或推荐。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Wertpapier-Signale analysieren, Signale vergleichen, Sektoren einordnen, Markt-Pulse abrufen

payload.name: Alpha Spread
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Supercharge your stock research in ChatGPT with Alpha Spread. Give your analysis a stronger foundation with intrinsic valuations, financial data, and models built for understanding what companies may be worth.

Develop more informed valuations, explore the assumptions behind them, and deepen your understanding of the companies you research, all within ChatGPT.

An Alpha Spread account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过Alpha Spread在ChatGPT中加速股票研究。
通过内在价值评估、财务数据以及用于理解公司价值的模型，为您的分析奠定更坚实的基础。

在ChatGPT内开发更明智的估值，探索其背后的假设，并加深对所研究公司的理解。

需要Alpha Spread账户。

payload.name: Prop Trading Intelligence
payload.description: 自营交易公司规则，附来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prop Trading Intelligence answers questions about prop trading firms' evaluation rules from a hand-checked dataset. Every rule value comes with a quote from the firm's own website, a link to that page and the date it was verified there.

Use it to:
- see which firms and programmes are covered
- find programmes that meet conditions such as news trading allowed, weekend holding, no consistency rule, a drawdown type, a minimum profit split, no time limit or a fee refund
- look up a programme's evaluation fees by account size, in the currency the firm lists
- read one firm's rules: profit targets, daily and maximum drawdown, time limits, minimum trading days, consistency, payouts and more
- get plain definitions of prop trading rules
- calculate a position size from account size, risk and stop loss, or the gain needed to recover from a drawdown

It is for traders researching prop firm evaluations and anyone learning how prop firm rules work. No sign-in is needed.

Limitations: the dataset covers forex and CFD programmes, and firms are added over time. A rule that has not been verified is reported as not yet verified, which means unknown, not absent. Firms can change their rules between checks, so every value shows its verified date and is flagged once a re-check is due. Fees are never converted between currencies. Results are listed alphabetically and are not a ranking or a recommendation. The plugin does not give trading advice, place trades, access trading accounts or sell anything.

The data is Pipster Research (CC BY 4.0), published by Data Vantix Ltd, which trades as Pipster, a prop firm. Pipster's own programmes are included and are checked by the same method as every other firm's.
payload.longDescription:
Prop Trading Intelligence 通过人工核查的数据集，解答关于自营交易公司评估规则的问题。每个规则值都附有该机构官网的引用、该页面链接以及验证日期。

可用于：
- 查看哪些机构和项目被覆盖
- 查找符合特定条件的项目，如允许新闻交易、周末持仓、无一致性规则、特定回撤类型、最低利润分成、无时间限制或费用退款
- 按账户规模查询项目的评估费用，以机构列出的货币计价
- 阅读某家机构的规则：盈利目标、每日及最大回撤、时间限制、最低交易天数、一致性要求、收益分配等
- 获取自营交易规则的明确定义
- 根据账户规模、风险和止损计算仓位大小，或计算回撤后所需盈利金额

适用于研究自营交易公司评估的交易者以及了解自营交易规则运作机制的人士。
无需登录即可使用。

限制条件：数据集涵盖外汇和差价合约项目，机构会随时间逐步增加。
未验证的规则会标注为「尚未验证」，表示信息未知而非规则缺失。
机构可能在核查间隔期内修改规则，因此每个数据项均显示验证日期，并在重新核查到期时标记提醒。
费用不会在不同货币间转换。
结果按字母顺序排列，不代表排名或推荐。
该插件不提供交易建议、不执行交易、不访问交易账户且不销售任何产品。

数据来源为 Pipster Research（CC BY 4.0），由 Data Vantix Ltd 发布，该公司以 Pipster 名义运营，是一家自营交易公司。
Pipster 自身的项目也包含在内，并采用与其他机构相同的核查方法。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List the prop firms and programmes covered, Find programmes by rule, Look up evaluation fees by account size, Read a firm's rules with sources, Explain prop trading rules, Calculate position size, Calculate drawdown recovery

payload.name: Changelly

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check crypto swap rates without leaving the chat. This plugin connects ChatGPT to Changelly's live exchange. Get a real-time quote with the current rate. 700+ coins across many networks

When you're happy with the estimate, it generates a ready-to-use Changelly link with your pair, amount and network pre-filled. The exchange itself takes place on changelly.com.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天界面即可查看加密货币兑换汇率。
此插件将ChatGPT连接至Changelly实时交易所。
获取当前汇率的实时报价，支持700多种币种，覆盖多个网络

实际的兑换操作将在changelly.com进行。

payload.name: Aveon Sigorta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aveon Sigorta is a licensed insurance company in the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (KKTC / TRNC). With this plugin you can see Aveon's 17 insurance products (traffic, kasko, home, health, travel health, workplace, cyber, construction, professional liability and more) and send a quote request so an Aveon agent calls you back.

The plugin only registers a callback request after you review and confirm the details you share (name, mobile number, product, and optionally email, coverage amount and a short note). It does not calculate prices, issue policies or handle claims. For claims, call Aveon's 24/7 claims line; compulsory traffic policies can also be bought online at police.aveoninsurance.com.
payload.longDescription:
Aveon Sigorta是土耳其共和国北塞浦路斯（KKTC/TRNC）的持牌保险公司。通过此插件，您可以查看Aveon的17种保险产品（交通险、车险、家庭险、健康险、旅行健康险、职场险、网络险、建筑险、职业责任险等），并提交报价请求，Aveon代理人将回电与您联系。

payload.name: Floyd by The F Suite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The F Suite is a members-only community of CFOs and their finance teams. Floyd brings the community's collective experience and knowledge into ChatGPT and Codex, so finance leaders can see what peers at comparable companies and in similar situations actually did before making a decision.

Floyd has two read-only tools:

get_peer_insights answers questions of practice and judgment: how CFOs structure a board package, what a normal burn multiple looks like at Series B, how teams handled a covenant breach or a restatement. It draws on 2,800+ discussion threads across eight CFO peer networks, shared models and templates, and F Suite event recordings.

find_vendors names specific software vendors; audit, accounting, and tax firms; service providers; and individual practitioners. Its recommendations come from 6,000+ peer mentions rather than analyst grids or vendor marketing.

Every response includes inline citations linking back to the original F Suite discussion threads, documents, events, and recordings, so answers can be checked at the source.

Floyd is called only when it is relevant to the question at hand; nothing is pushed into the conversation. Access requires an active F Suite membership. Every member connects to the same server URL and signs in with their F Suite account over OAuth 2.0, and each member's answers are scoped to the peer networks they belong to.
payload.longDescription:
The F Suite是面向CFO及其财务团队的会员制社区。Floyd将社区的集体经验和知识引入ChatGPT和Codex，使财务领导者在做决策前能查看同等规模公司和类似情况下的同行实际采取了哪些措施。

Floyd提供两个只读工具：

get_peer_insights用于解答实践与判断类问题：CFO如何构建董事会资料包？B轮融资阶段的正常烧钱倍数是什么样？团队如何处理契约违约或财务重述问题？该功能基于八个CFO同行网络中的2800+讨论帖、共享的模型模板以及F Suite活动记录。

find_vendors可查询具体的软件供应商、审计会计税务事务所、服务商及个人从业者。其推荐结果来自6000+同行提及记录，而非分析师榜单或供应商营销内容。

每个回答均包含内联引用，可链接回原始的F Suite讨论帖、文档、活动和录音，方便从源头核对信息。

只有在问题相关时才会调用Floyd，不会主动向对话中推送内容。访问需有效F Suite会员资格。每位成员通过OAuth 2.0协议使用F Suite账户登录同一服务器地址，且每位成员的回答内容仅限其所属的同行网络范围。

payload.name: Expat Savings Rates

See published rates from HSBC Expat, Standard Chartered Jersey, Skipton International, Barclays International and others, read from each bank's own page and dated. Accounts not open to your country of residence are removed. Each result shows the minimum deposit, who can open it and the compensation scheme that protects it. General information only, not personalised advice.

选择一种货币、账户类型和金额。
直接从HSBC Expat、标准渣打银行泽西分行、Skipton International、巴克莱国际银行等银行官网页面获取并标注日期的公开利率。

payload.name: Harmonic (new)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, enrich, and research startups, companies and investors using Harmonic's proprietary data on millions of companies and the people behind them. Get detailed company profiles with funding, location, founders, and network connections. Use natural language to find companies matching specific criteria. Create and manage lists of companies and people. Access your team's network mapping and saved searches. Discover startups earlier, research them faster, and act with confidence—an AI-powered research agent built into your workflow.
payload.longDescription:
利用Harmonic独有的数据，搜索、丰富并研究初创企业、公司和投资者，这些数据涵盖数百万家企业及其背后的人员。
获取包含融资信息、所在地、创始人及网络关系的详细公司档案。
通过自然语言查找符合特定条件的公司。
创建和管理公司及人员列表。
访问团队的网络图谱和保存的搜索记录。

payload.name: VUHL VA Loan Calculator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Veterans United Home Loans VA loan calculator helps Veterans and service members estimate their monthly mortgage payment. Enter details like home price, down payment, interest rate, loan term and military background, and it handles the rest, factoring in principal and interest, the VA funding fee, taxes and insurance. Whether you're buying a home or refinancing, it gives you a clear, complete payment picture without needing to know the fine print.

Calculator provided by Veterans United Home Loans. NMLS 1907 (www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org). Private Lender; Not endorsed or sponsored by the Dept. of Veterans Affairs or any government agency. Licensed in all 50 States. Equal Housing Opportunity.

Interest rates displayed in this calculator are shown for illustrative purposes only. Your rate may differ based on a variety of factors, including your credit score and the current market conditions. Taxes and Insurance amounts are estimates based on the loan amount.
payload.longDescription:
Veterans United Home Loans的VA贷款计算器帮助退伍军人和服务人员估算其每月抵押贷款还款额。输入房屋价格、首付、利率、贷款期限和军人背景等详细信息，其余内容将由计算器处理，包括本金和利息、VA资金费用、税费及保险。无论您是购买房屋还是再融资，都能在无需了解细则的情况下，为您提供清晰完整的还款概览。

本计算器由Veterans United Home Loans提供。NMLS 1907（www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org）。私人贷款机构，未得到退伍军人事务部或任何政府机构的赞助或认可。在全美50个州持牌经营。平等住房机会提供者。

本计算器显示的利率仅用于示例展示。您的实际利率可能因多种因素而有所不同，包括信用评分和当前市场状况。税费和保险金额是基于贷款金额的估算值。

payload.name: Cadence Money
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Cadence account and ask about your own money in plain language: how your budgets are tracking this month, what you can still spend this week, which bills are due soon, how your spending compares to last month, how your goals are progressing, and how your net worth has changed over time.

Answers come from your live Cadence data each time you ask. The connection is read-only: ChatGPT can read your budgets, transactions, accounts, bills, income, goals and investments, but it cannot move money, edit anything, or connect new accounts. You can disconnect at any time from ChatGPT or from Settings in Cadence.
payload.longDescription:
连接您的Cadence账户后，用自然语言询问自己的财务状况：本月预算执行情况、本周剩余可支配金额、即将到期的账单、支出与上月的对比、目标完成进度，以及净资产随时间的变化情况。

每次提问时，答案都会基于您最新的Cadence数据实时生成。
连接为只读模式：ChatGPT可读取您的预算、交易记录、账户信息、账单、收入、目标和投资数据，但无法操作资金、修改内容或添加新账户。
您可随时通过ChatGPT或Cadence的设置界面断开连接。

payload.name: Creddy: Credit Card Rewards
payload.description: 信用卡权益、信用额度和积分
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Creddy helps you get more from the credit cards you have and choose the next one with care.

Ask which of your cards to use at a store or for a category, and Creddy ranks your cards by effective return: each card's earn rate multiplied by Creddy's estimate of what its points are worth. Ask what a card includes and Creddy shows its annual fee, earn rates, statement credits with when each one resets, lounge access, elite status, insurance and purchase protections, foreign transaction fee, and current welcome offer. Compare two or three cards side by side, get a short list of cards to consider for a spend category, no annual fee, or lounge access, and see where a points currency transfers, at what ratio, and which transfer bonuses are running now.

Card data comes from Creddy's reviewed catalog of US credit cards, built from each issuer's published terms and kept current by the Creddy team. Card names can be written the way people say them, such as "Amex Gold" or "CSR".

Limitations: Creddy covers US consumer and business credit cards only. It does not need an account, never asks for card numbers or login details, and cannot apply for cards, move points, or make purchases. Point values are estimates, and offers and terms can change, so confirm the details with the issuer before you apply. Some answers include links to issuer application pages, and Creddy may earn a commission if you apply.
payload.longDescription:
Creddy帮助您充分利用现有信用卡并谨慎选择下一张信用卡。

询问在商店或某个消费类别中使用哪张信用卡时，Creddy会根据实际回报率对信用卡进行排序：每张信用卡的积分返现率乘以Creddy对积分价值的估算。
询问某张信用卡的权益内容时，Creddy会显示年费、积分返现率、账单抵扣及其重置时间、休息室访问权限、高级会员资格、保险和购物保护、外币交易费以及当前的开卡礼遇。
将两张或三张信用卡并排对比，获取针对特定消费类别、无年费或休息室权限的候选卡清单，并查看积分货币的兑换比例、当前可兑换的积分奖励及兑换优惠。

信用卡数据来自Creddy经过审核的美国信用卡目录，该目录基于发卡机构公开条款建立，并由Creddy团队持续更新。
信用卡名称可使用人们常用的写法，例如「Amex Gold」或「CSR」。

限制条件：Creddy仅支持美国消费者和商务信用卡。
无需账户即可使用，不会要求输入卡号或登录信息，也无法申请信用卡、转移积分或进行购物。
积分价值为估算值，且优惠条款可能变动，请在申请前与发卡机构确认详细信息。
部分回答包含发卡机构申请页面链接，若通过这些链接申请，Creddy可能获得佣金。

payload.name: Trackstone
payload.description: 出租房产：价格与回报率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out what your rented property is worth, or find one that already pays rent, without leaving the conversation.

Trackstone is a French real estate agency dedicated to rented properties: the property is sold with its tenant in place, and the lease simply continues with the new owner. The seller does not wait for the tenant to leave, and the buyer collects rent from day one.

What you can do:
- Value your rented apartment or house. Get a price range, the price per square meter and the gross yield your property offers a buyer, calculated from real comparable sales in your area (French public land registry, DVF), with a reliability score from 1 to 5.
- Browse rented properties for sale. Tell ChatGPT your city, your budget and the gross or net yield you are aiming for: Trackstone shows matching listings with photos, price, rent and both yields, sorted by the yield that matters to you.
- Read a city's market at a glance: price per square meter for apartments and houses, how prices have moved year after year, median rent and gross yield.

From any result, one click takes you to Trackstone to open the detailed estimate, view the listing or talk to an advisor about your sale.

Made for owners who want to sell a rented property in France, and for investors who want a property that earns rent from the first month.

Good to know: France only. Estimates cover apartments and houses; they are indicative, not formal appraisals, and less precise where few sales exist. Search results only include properties published publicly on Trackstone. No account is required, and the plugin never makes offers or transactions on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话界面，即可了解您的出租房产价值，或寻找已产生租金收益的房产。

Trackstone是一家法国房地产中介，专注出租房产交易：房产连同租客一并出售，租赁合同由新业主继续履行。卖方无需等待租客搬离，买方从成交第一天起即可收取租金。

您可以：
- 评估出租公寓或住宅价值
获取价格区间、每平方米价格及买家可获得的毛回报率，该数据基于您所在区域的真实成交案例（法国公共土地登记处DVF数据），并附带1到5分的可靠性评分。
- 浏览待售出租房产
告诉ChatGPT您的城市、预算以及目标毛回报率或净回报率：Trackstone将展示匹配房源，包含照片、价格、租金及两种回报率，按您关注的回报率排序。
- 快速了解城市市场情况：公寓和住宅的每平方米价格、历年价格变化趋势、中位租金及毛回报率。

在任何搜索结果页面，一键跳转至Trackstone查看详细估价、房源信息或联系顾问咨询出售事宜。

专为希望出售法国出租房产的业主，以及希望获得首月即可产生租金收益房产的投资者设计。

重要说明：仅适用于法国。
估价范围包括公寓和住宅；估价结果仅供参考，非正式评估报告，在成交案例较少的区域可能精度较低。
搜索结果仅包含Trackstone平台公开发布的房源。
无需账户即可使用，插件不会以您的名义进行任何报价或交易。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Estimate a rented property, Search rented properties for sale, Check city real estate prices

payload.name: Keel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keel turns your ideas into systematic strategies for Hyperliquid crypto perpetual futures (perps). Connect it to ChatGPT, describe a strategy, and ChatGPT builds it from Keel's strategy components, backtests it on real Hyperliquid history with fees and slippage, and explains the results.

With Keel in ChatGPT you can:
- Build and edit strategies by describing them
- Backtest them and compare runs side by side
- Start from a verified strategy in the Keel library
- Keep notes on strategies and share a result by link
- See how the strategies you run in Keel are doing

Everything you create stays in your Keel workspace. Nothing is public unless you share it.

Keel in ChatGPT is for strategy research and backtesting. It does not place trades, submit orders, move funds or connect wallets — no order executes inside ChatGPT. What it writes is limited to your own Keel workspace: strategy drafts, backtest runs, notes and share links. Running a strategy with real capital is set up and approved by you in the Keel web app, outside ChatGPT. Backtests are simulations on historical data, not predictions or financial advice; trading perpetual futures carries a substantial risk of loss.

Keel measures the strategies you design. It does not give investment advice or recommendations, and backtest results do not predict future returns.
payload.longDescription:
Keel 将您的想法转化为适用于 Hyperliquid 加密货币永续期货（perps）的系统化策略。连接至 ChatGPT，描述策略，ChatGPT 将基于 Keel 的策略组件构建策略，使用手续费和滑点在真实 Hyperliquid 历史数据上进行回测，并解释结果。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Keel 可实现：
- 通过描述构建和编辑策略
- 进行回测并并排比较不同运行结果
- 从 Keel 库中已验证的策略开始
- 为策略添加备注并通过链接分享结果
- 查看您在 Keel 中运行的策略表现

您创建的所有内容都会保存在个人 Keel 工作区中。
除非您主动分享，否则内容不会公开。

ChatGPT 中的 Keel 仅用于策略研究和回测。
它不会执行交易、提交订单、转移资金或连接钱包——ChatGPT 内部不会执行任何订单。
其生成内容仅限于您的个人 Keel 工作区：策略草案、回测记录、备注和分享链接。
使用真实资金运行策略需在 Keel 网页应用中独立完成，且需您自行设置并确认。
回测基于历史数据模拟，非未来预测或金融建议；交易永续期货存在重大亏损风险。

Keel 会评估您设计的策略。
但不会提供投资建议或推荐，回测结果不预示未来收益。

payload.name: MortgageCompare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare two to four U.S. fixed-rate mortgage offers for the same loan amount using confirmed Loan Estimate figures. See payments, discount points, closing fees, lender credits, prepaid interest and mortgage insurance alongside financing cost over the time you expect to keep the loan. Change the holding period, inspect cost crossovers, principal repaid and remaining balances, and export your comparison. ChatGPT can help read Loan Estimates attached to your conversation; MortgageCompare receives structured financial figures, not the original documents. No live rate shopping, lender referrals, applications or approval decisions. The model supports fully amortizing loans, cash-paid fees and an explicit constant mortgage-insurance amount/duration. Confirm figures with your lenders.
payload.longDescription:
使用确认的贷款估算数据，比较2至4份相同贷款金额的美国固定利率抵押贷款报价。
显示还款金额、折扣点、结案费用、贷款人信用额度、预付利息和抵押贷款保险费用，以及您预计持有贷款期间的融资成本。
调整持有期限，查看成本交叉点、已还本金和剩余余额，并导出您的比较结果。
ChatGPT可帮助解读您对话中附加的贷款估算文件；MortgageCompare接收结构化财务数据，而非原始文件。
不提供实时利率比价、贷款机构推荐、申请或审批决策。
该模型支持全额摊销贷款、现金支付费用以及明确的固定抵押贷款保险金额/期限。
请与贷款机构确认数据准确性。

payload.name: Redbark
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Redbark connects your bank and brokerage accounts in Australia, New Zealand and the United States, and syncs them to Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, YNAB or a webhook.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can read the accounts you have connected to Redbark:
- Balances across all your accounts
- Transactions, with search by date, amount and description
- Spending summaries by category and merchant
- Brokerage holdings and trades
- The status of your syncs, with a diagnosis when one fails

It can also start a sync run on request, and give you a link to connect a new bank.

The plugin is read-only for your bank accounts. It cannot move money, make payments or place trades. It only sees accounts you have connected to your own Redbark account.

Requires a Redbark account.
payload.longDescription:
Redbark可连接澳大利亚、新西兰和美国的银行账户及经纪账户，并将数据同步至Google Sheets、Airtable、Notion、YNAB或网络钩子

通过此插件，ChatGPT可读取你已连接至Redbark的账户信息：

该插件仅对银行账户保持只读模式
无法执行资金转账、支付操作或下单交易

需要拥有Redbark账户

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your saved Finnce records to understand your portfolio and organize your investment research. With your permission, read saved portfolios, positions, purchases and sales; review watchlists and existing alerts; add an asset to a selected watchlist; and create or review thesis, contingency, review and checklist drafts. payload.longDescription:
使用您保存的Finnce记录来了解您的投资组合并整理投资研究资料。
在获得您的授权后，可读取保存的投资组合、持仓、买入和卖出记录；查看关注列表和现有警报；将资产添加到选定的关注列表中；创建或查看投资逻辑、应急方案、复盘和检查清单草案。

通过此连接创建新价格警报的功能目前暂不可用。
需要Finnce账户和完成连接；单独安装插件不会授予访问权限。

payload.name: Daffy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Daffy is a donor-advised fund: one account for all your giving. Add cash, stock, or crypto, get your tax deduction when you contribute, invest it to grow tax-free, and give to any of 1.5 million+ US charities whenever you're ready.

With Daffy in ChatGPT, your giving is one question away:

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Derived figures are labelled with the metrics they were derived from. Companies whose fiscal years end on different dates are flagged rather than blended into a single comparison.

payload.longDescription:

可用于股权和信用研究、验证公司实际披露内容、准备财报日、构建可比公司分析，并追溯数值对应的原始文件记录。

限制条件：仅限在美国上市的公司。插件为只读模式，不支持交易、无经纪账户访问权限，也不允许修改投资组合或账户信息。返回内容不构成投资建议或推荐。文件内容仅以摘要形式返回，而非完整文档。数据遵循SEC文件提交日历，而非实时更新，今日提交的文件可能需等到下次索引更新后才能显示。

- Federal income tax with 2026 brackets and standard deductions, the child tax credit, and the new deductions for qualified tips, overtime premium pay and seniors
- Social Security and Medicare, including the wage base cap and the additional Medicare tax
- State income tax for all 50 states and Washington, D.C.
- City and county income taxes such as New York City, Yonkers, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Detroit, Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Kansas City, St. Louis, Louisville, Wilmington, Portland and Multnomah County, and every Maryland county
- State payroll deductions like California SDI, New York and New Jersey disability and paid family leave, and paid leave programs in Washington, Massachusetts, Oregon, Colorado and other states

- Weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly and monthly pay schedules, and single, married and head of household filing

Comparing job offers or thinking about moving? The job offer comparison puts 2 to 4 salaries side by side across states and cities and shows how much more you keep with each.

TakeHome needs no account and does not store what you enter. Results are estimates for planning based on published 2026 tax rules, not tax advice. Actual paychecks depend on your W-4 and your employer's withholding.
payload.longDescription:
了解您实际到手的工资数额。

您可以询问类似「在科罗拉多州 95,000 美元的收入税后能拿多少」「每小时 28 美元税后收入多少」或「比较纽约市 14 万美元与奥斯汀 12 万美元的收入差异」的问题。
TakeHome 会展示您税后的工资明细，清晰列出每一项扣除项，并支持在聊天中直接切换发薪频率、州、申报状态和 401(k) 选项。

计算内容包括：
- 2026 年度联邦所得税，包括税率等级和标准扣除额、儿童税收抵免，以及针对合格小费、加班补贴和老年人的新扣除项
- 社会保障税和医疗保险税，包含工资基数上限和附加医疗保险税
- 所有 50 个州及华盛顿特区的州所得税
- 纽约市、扬克斯、费城、匹兹堡、底特律、哥伦布、克利夫兰、辛辛那提、堪萨斯城、圣路易斯、路易斯维尔、威尔明顿、波特兰和马尔特诺马县等城市和县的所得税，以及所有马里兰州县
- 加州残疾保险（SDI）、纽约和新泽西州的残疾及带薪家庭假、华盛顿、马萨诸塞、俄勒冈、科罗拉多等州的带薪休假计划
- 传统 401(k) 和 403(b) 退休金、税前健康福利、HSA 和 FSA、奖金、时薪加班和小费
- 每周、双周、半月和月结发薪方式，以及单身、已婚和户主申报状态

在比较工作机会或考虑搬家时？
工作机会对比功能可将 2 至 4 个跨州和城市的薪资并列展示，清晰显示每份工作的实际到手收入差异。

TakeHome 无需账户且不会保存您输入的任何信息。
结果仅为基于 2026 年税法规定的估算数据，不构成税务建议。

payload.name: Earnings Feed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research public SEC records with Earnings Feed. Look up a company by ticker or CIK; list recent filings by filer and form type; find filings by company name or ticker; inspect a filing's metadata and document list; and review disclosed insider transactions. Results include filing accessions and links to SEC sources and Earnings Feed.

Filing search matches filer company names or tickers, not the text inside filings. Filing detail returns metadata and document names, not document text or quoted passages. Results reflect the records available when requested.

payload.longDescription:
通过Earnings Feed研究公开的SEC记录。通过股票代码或CIK查找公司；按申报方和文件类型列出最近的文件；通过公司名称或股票代码查找文件；检查文件的元数据和文档列表；查看披露的内部人员交易。结果包含文件接入编号以及到SEC来源和Earnings Feed的链接。

文件搜索仅匹配申报公司名称或股票代码，而非文件内的文本内容。文件详情仅返回元数据和文档名称，而非文档正文或引用内容。所有权文件可能包含不同的申报方和发行人。内部人员买入和卖出过滤器包含奖励、赠与和其他交易类型，而不仅仅是场内买卖。结果反映请求时可用的记录。

payload.name: Kryptos
payload.description: 加密货币组合、税务及账簿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kryptos brings your crypto portfolio, transaction history, tax figures and accounting ledger into ChatGPT, across 5,000+ exchanges, wallets and blockchains.

Ask what you hold and what it is worth, search your transaction history by asset, wallet, label or date, review DeFi positions and NFT collections, and look at the ledger detail behind any trade.

Kryptos also finds the data problems that make crypto tax wrong — missing prices, missing cost basis, sells with no matching purchase, balances that disagree with the ledger, wallets you never connected — and lets you fix them in the same conversation: recategorise a transaction, correct a price, merge a transfer that detection missed, or add a trade that never made it into an export.

Finance teams can map transactions to a chart of accounts, apply categorisation rules, generate double-entry journals and push them to Xero, QuickBooks or Softledger.

You sign in to Kryptos with OAuth and grant access to one workspace. Kryptos never asks for exchange API keys or wallet private keys in the conversation. It reads and records only — no tool can send, swap, withdraw, deposit or trade any asset.

Requires a Kryptos account.
payload.longDescription:
Kryptos将您的加密货币组合、交易记录、税务数据和会计分录整合到ChatGPT中，覆盖5000多个交易所、钱包和区块链。

您可以询问自己持有哪些资产及其价值，按资产、钱包、标签或日期搜索交易记录，查看DeFi持仓和NFT收藏，查阅任何交易背后的分录明细。

Kryptos在对话中从不请求交易所API密钥或钱包私钥。
它仅执行读取和记录操作——任何工具都无法发送、交换、提现、存款或交易任何资产。

需要Kryptos账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Portfolio and holdings, Transaction history, Data quality checks, Tax reports and cost basis, Chart of accounts and ERP journals

payload.name: Modern Collections
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Modern Collections is a collection agency for unpaid business-to-business invoices. When a customer won't pay, is past due, or has gone quiet on an overdue invoice, send it to collections from ChatGPT or Codex and we recover the B2B debt for you: we email and call the business that owes you, handle disputes, and pay out what we collect.

With this plugin you can:
- Place an overdue or unpaid invoice for collection and attach the invoice and supporting documents.
- See where each account stands: every email and call, why outreach is paused, disputes, payment promises and payments.
- Answer disputes and evidence requests, record a payment the debtor made to you directly, update debtor contacts, or recall a placement.
- Check amounts collected, fees, payouts (remittances) and monthly statements.

Anything that contacts a debtor, records money or changes an account asks for confirmation first. You need a Modern Collections creditor account; placing invoices requires a verified account with a signed agreement. Business debts only: consumer debt is not accepted.
payload.longDescription:
Modern Collections是针对未支付商业对商业发票的催收机构。当客户拒绝付款、逾期未付或对逾期发票保持沉默时，您可通过ChatGPT或Codex将账单发送至催收服务，我们将为您追回B2B债务：我们会向欠款企业发送邮件和致电沟通，处理争议，并将追回款项支付给您。

通过此插件您可以：
- 将逾期或未支付的发票提交催收并附上发票及支持文件。
- 查看每个账户的最新状态：每封邮件和每次电话沟通记录、联络暂停原因、争议情况、付款承诺及实际付款情况。
- 回应争议和证据请求，直接记录债务人向您支付的款项，更新债务人联系方式或撤回已提交的账单。

任何接触债务人、记录资金流动或修改账户信息的操作均需先获得确认。
您需要拥有Modern Collections债权人账户；提交账单需使用已验证账户并签署协议。
仅处理商业债务：不接受消费者债务。

payload.name: Glimps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Read-only: Glimps for ChatGPT cannot upload, change, approve, book, or pay invoices. Access follows your current Glimps role. payload.name: Minhas Finanças
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Minhas Finanças account to view balances, income, expenses, cards, budgets, goals, loans, and notes. Compare periods, filter reports, project cash flow from recorded transactions, and access in-app help. Projections do not represent real-time bank balances or guarantee outcomes. Budget management, including creation and individual deletion, requires new authorization and always requires review and confirmation; deleting a budget does not delete its transactions. payload.name: Jemma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jemma answers nurse pay questions with real math. Ask what you'll take home at your hourly rate, what a travel contract is worth after tax, whether a 1099 or locums rate beats a staff job, what you'd need to earn to move cities, or what nurses with your credential earn in your state. No account needed, and Jemma never asks for your license number or your salary inside ChatGPT. Estimates, not tax advice.

payload.name: PayFresco Payment Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PayFresco Payment Planner helps a merchant compare a registration country, customer markets, billing model, presentment currencies, settlement currencies, and payment methods with a catalog of PayFresco capabilities. It separates documented, conditional, unsupported, and unknown requirements. It builds a preparation checklist for policies, refunds, fulfillment, billing disclosures, currency handling, and authentication questions, and it keeps the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the EEA distinct. It builds a settlement route table and calculates a converted amount only when the user supplies the amount and the rate.

Approved coverage is conditional on underwriting and setup. It is not merchant approval. Entities outside comprehensively sanctioned jurisdictions may apply, and no US SSN or ITIN is needed to apply. This app never collects those numbers. Customer markets can be any non-sanctioned country, with the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the EEA kept distinct. Presentment currencies, settlement currencies, routes, and payment methods follow that approved catalog, including EUR to USD and GBP to USD, with conversion only when the currencies differ. Fees, reserves, and payout timing stay unknown. The app does not approve a merchant, move money, submit an application, or contact anyone. It does not store what you type. Do not enter card numbers, government IDs, or bank details. Some product categories are outside what this ChatGPT app will plan. Results are planning information, not legal or underwriting advice. OpenAI has not endorsed this app.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Payment setup comparison, Readiness checklist, Currency settlement plan

payload.name: MoveSurge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MoveSurge is a real-time market news tape for US equities and cross-asset macro that measures what each event did to the price. For eligible headlines it records the instrument price immediately before the headline was published, one minute after and ten minutes after, plus volume against its usual level for that window, so each move is tied to the event that caused it.

With this plugin you can:
- Ask why something suddenly moved. MoveSurge detects abnormal moves in oil, index futures, currencies and stocks, investigates them, and publishes the cause it found with the evidence, a confidence level and how the move followed through.
- Check earnings: EPS and revenue against the consensus estimate, beat or miss, guidance direction and the stock's measured reaction to the release, plus who reports next.
- Check economic data: CPI, payrolls, PMIs and central-bank decisions with actual, forecast and previous, the surprise, and what markets did in the minutes after the print, plus the releases scheduled ahead.
- Follow President Trump's Truth Social posts as they cross the tape, with the measured reaction where a post moved an instrument.
- Search the tape by topic or ticker, rank the events with the largest measured moves in a window, or pull a ticker's recent catalysts with the price path on each.
- Read explainer articles in full with their sources.

The coverage_stats tool reports live counts of events, measured reactions and tickers covered, so the figures can be checked.

Read-only: the tools do not write, trade or place orders, and the results are not investment advice.

information.value: Explain sudden price moves with the cause, evidence and confidence MoveSurge found, Earnings results against estimates with the stock's measured reaction, plus upcoming reports, Trump's Truth Social posts with the measured market reaction, Search market headlines with the price change measured around each one, Rank the events with the largest measured price moves in a time window, List a ticker's recent headlines with the price path recorded for each, Read explainer articles with their sources, Report live coverage statistics

payload.name: RetryHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RetryHub helps ecommerce and subscription merchants prepare for a high-risk merchant account review. It gives a qualitative fit hint from the niche, monthly volume, country, and what happened with the current processor. It walks through a checklist after a shutdown or fund hold. It calculates a simple dispute ratio and sets that figure next to publicly described Visa VAMP and Mastercard monitoring thresholds, with the sources named.

The app does not approve an account, quote a rate or a fee, or promise a timeline. It is not legal or financial advice. It does not store what you type. Card numbers, government IDs, and bank details should not be entered. Some product categories are out of scope for this ChatGPT app.

When a result includes a next step, it links to the RetryHub application at retryhub.com/apply and to Telegram at t.me/RetryHubBot. Those links can include a source parameter so RetryHub can measure referrals from this app. The parameter does not include your answers.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Merchant account fit hint, Shutdown checklist, Dispute ratio check

payload.name: MLS Colombia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MLS Colombia answers two common questions about the Colombian property market inside ChatGPT with no account needed.

How much is my house worth?
Tell ChatGPT the municipality or city, whether it is a house (casa) or an apartment (apartamento) and the built area in square meters (plus the lot for a house). You get an indicative sale range in Colombian pesos (low, mid and high), an approximate US dollar figure at the dated TRM exchange rate, a confidence label (alta, media or baja) and, when available, the expected monthly rent. It is an informal estimate: useful to orient yourself before talking to an advisor, not a substitute for a certified commercial appraisal.

Real estate agencies in your city
Ask for inmobiliarias in Bogotá, Medellín, Cali or any other city and get some public directory entries from MLS Colombia, each with a link to its profile. Entries are public and are not endorsements; each firm can claim and confirm its profile.

How it works
The plugin is read-only: it does not post, send messages or change anything. It does not ask for your name, email or phone, and it does not store your queries. Answers appear as a card in the conversation and as plain text, so they work on any screen. If you want to continue, you can ask an advisor for a valuation; that step happens outside ChatGPT, at mlscolombia.co/valorar, and you decide whether to leave your details.

What it does not do
It does not value land or fincas, does not issue a certified appraisal and does not give legal, tax or financial advice.

Examples: "How much is my 120 m2 house in Rionegro worth?", "Estimate a 70 m2 apartment in Medellín", "Real estate agencies in Bogotá", "Inmobiliarias in Cartagena".

Support: https://mlscolombia.co/soporte/

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Estimate a sale price range, Estimate monthly rent, Find inmobiliarias by city

payload.name: COROS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your COROS account to explore private activity records, laps and FIT files; understand sleep, heart rate, HRV, stress, wellness checks, menstrual cycle data, fitness and recovery; and view your profile and devices. Create and update running, cycling and trail-running training plans and workouts, save reusable workout templates, and arrange workouts on your training schedule. Changes are saved to your COROS account only when requested. Health insights are informational, not medical diagnosis or treatment.

Track weight, body composition, and menstrual cycle data. Monitor long-term fitness trends with up to 5 years of history. All data displays include Garmin attribution.

payload.name: Tredict
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tredict is a platform for endurance training planning, structured workouts, and workout analysis for athletes and coaches.

Create reusable training plans and structured workouts for running, cycling, swimming, and other sports directly in Tredict with ChatGPT. Plans can be tailored to your recent activities and preferred training approach, whether based on power, pace, or other performance metrics.

Execute your training plan directly on your sports watch through Tredict’s integrations with Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Wahoo, Coros, and other platforms.

Organize your training calendar with AI-powered assistance that helps summarize workouts and suggest meaningful titles and descriptions for your training sessions.

Analyze past training activities and generate structured workout plans that support long-term endurance training.

分析过往训练活动，并生成支持长期耐力训练的结构化训练计划。
